title: Mercedes-Benz V 300 Marco Polo
subtitle: 4MATIC · Original Westfalia camper · 08/2019 · Rome, Italy
description:
Mercedes-Benz V 300 Marco Polo 4MATIC with an original Westfalia camper conversion, first registered in August 2019. Offered by a private seller in Rome at €44,900, with 106,000 km.

The seller describes an electric pop-up roof with an upper double bed, a kitchen with sink, hob and refrigerator, a rear-seat bed, side awning and Webasto stationary heating. Premium equipment includes full leather upholstery, navigation, parking cameras and sensors, adaptive cruise control, LED headlights and heated front seats.

The seller states that the vehicle has had one owner, regular Mercedes-Benz servicing, documented services, certified mileage, excellent bodywork and Bridgestone tyres in excellent condition, with a full service booklet and motorhome registration. These are statements from the seller.

Source discrepancies requiring clarification: the structured listing marks the vehicle as accident-damaged, while the seller says there have been no accidents. Structured power is 174 kW / 237 hp, while the description gives 177 kW / 239 hp. Emissions are listed as Euro 6d and Euro 6d-TEMP respectively; climate control is listed as 3-zone and 2-zone respectively. The equipment list also contains a range extender and heat pump for this diesel vehicle. All entries are retained as supplied; MLT certification has not been claimed.
included:
